meta.title: A user cannot bid for a company they are not entitled to
warnings: a read-back was added in code: As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (nothing was created).

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round with the company uuid set to “…”.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (nothing was created).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to perform this action”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the round counts no new bid (nothing was created).
